mission: SMC-M01 living brief and text conversation
authority: Direct owner active goal: ledger, merge PR18, new PR implementing agreed design, Claude review via chat, exact candidate production release, text UI test and iterate

decisions.decision: One living project brief replaces compact mission panel and duplicate brief/status cards in the primary conversation view.
Brief updates during voice and text conversation from the canonical mission ledger without an explicit create-brief request.
Editable lifecycle sections include direction, observations, expectations, outcomes, blockers, hypotheses and lessons; users can add, edit, correct and forget directly or ask Sophia.
Manual edits take priority; live changes must not overwrite an edit in progress or steal focus/scroll.
Remove provider/model drafting labels, raw cited input IDs and source hashes from user-facing brief; retain provenance internally.
Primary view is real text chat with visible user messages and Sophia replies, not contribution-only storage.
Brief closed: unobtrusive visible Open brief control with quiet saved-update indicator.
Brief open: side panel beside conversation; expand to full workspace and collapse back to side panel.
On mobile brief becomes full-screen view with Back to conversation control.
Brief updated indicator is shown only after durable save receipt.
Voice and text use the same canonical living brief and lifecycle tools.
Implementation brief remains a separate deliverable outside the main conversation view when needed.
Structured note capture on by default for every team; off switch in settings; preserve individual consent and explicit opt-outs; compatible existing-team transition required.
No new raw audio recording or ambient transcript retention; visible typed chat requires explicit candidate-defined storage/privacy contract.
Do not independently rewrite fixed v1.1 assets; exact candidate asset and combined identities verified before release.

writing_scope: New isolated branch/worktree in Sophia; application/contracts/persistence/UI/tests and non-frozen docs required for these decisions. Legacy Sophia-Agent excluded. Frozen pack and v1.1 assets preserved unless separately versioned amendment.
release_scope: Existing Sophia API/bridge/Studio and existing Supabase; exact reviewed candidate and authored migration hashes/order/keys must be recorded; existing providers/payers/plans; no destructive downgrade or extra bill.
candidate_status: Local source in verification; exact candidate hash to be posted after publication

contract_choices.typed_chat: Bounded ephemeral UI history, recipient-scoped; no raw transcript or browser-storage persistence. Canonical structured notes are durable under project policy and individual consent.
contract_choices.source_attribution: A09 + 0020 record bridge-derived text or voice origin; model arguments cannot choose actor or mode.
contract_choices.compatible_recovery: New text-origin data requires A09 readers. Preserve 0018 history; migrate 0019/0020 in a quiet release window, then API/bridge/Studio. Worker/runtime stay at 0391bc6 pending PR16. No old-code-only rollback after new data.
contract_choices.test_project_capture: Owner later default-on product direction supersedes automatic off cleanup for the prior consenting owner test project; preserve its existing automatic row and member consent. No other member consent changed.
